target.title: improve(android): manage configured model providers
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Resolves a problem where Android users could only see provider readiness summaries in Settings > Providers & Models, without a clear list of configured model IDs or direct controls to verify, add, or remove configured models.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a configured-model management path for the Android app. The screen now loads the configured model view, expands each provider to show its model IDs, and exposes model availability checks plus add/remove controls.

Model configuration writes are handled by new `models.configure` and `models.remove` gateway RPC methods that operate on `snapshot.sourceConfig`, not the runtime-expanded config. That keeps Android from accidentally persisting bundled/default runtime model catalog entries when adding or removing one model.

## User Impact

Android users can now:

- View configured model providers and the detailed model IDs under each provider.
- Refresh provider/model availability from Gateway.
- Test whether an individual model is currently available from the Gateway catalog/readiness view.
- Add or update a configured model ID without editing config files manually.
- Remove an authored provider model with a confirmation dialog.

## Evidence

Code/test coverage added:

- Added Android UI/state tests in `ProviderModelStatusTest` for provider model rows, availability readiness, and model-test result keys.
- Added gateway handler tests in `config.shared-auth.test.ts` proving `models.configure` and `models.remove` write only authored provider models and do not persist runtime-only default catalog entries.
- Added explicit method-scope assertions for `models.configure` and `models.remove` as `operator.admin` methods.
- Updated `apps/.i18n/native-source.json` for the new Android strings.

Local lightweight checks:

- `pnpm native:i18n:check` passed.
- `pnpm exec oxlint src/gateway/server-methods/config.ts src/gateway/server-methods/config.shared-auth.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.

GitHub Actions on PR #101912 / latest commit `9799aeddc7`:

- `android-build-play` passed.
- `android-ktlint` passed.
- `android-test-play` passed.
- `android-test-third-party` passed.
- `check-lint` passed.
- `check-test-types` passed.
- `native-i18n` passed.
- `check-prod-types` passed.
- Security, dependency guard, label, and critical quality checks reported passing/skipped as applicable.

Not run locally:

- Android Gradle build/ktlint/test suites were not run locally; full Android validation was performed by GitHub Actions above.

Additional note:

- The local graphify rebuild was attempted after code edits. It reached AST extraction completion but was killed by the local 120s command timeout before a clean exit; no `graphify-out` files are tracked in this PR.
